notes: full includes observation, planning and review; gold-scene receives the author-supplied scene, so its total latency/tokens cannot be directly compared with full.
All model turns share 14 seconds, at most 2 plans and 2 reviews: full normally 3, at most 5 provider calls; gold-scene normally 2, at most 4.
Gold-plan does not call a provider. It measures deterministic acceptance of author-designed geometry and known malformed controls, not model skill.
Every failure remains in its executed denominator. Missing usage stays null. No prices or cost estimates are invented.
Semantic negatives can pass geometry: this is reported as unreviewed, never semantic success.

samples.dining_chair: Despite plausible rectangle placement, model calls the chair an easel/frame and the addition paper: identity error.
samples.sail_hull: Flag floats beside the sail rather than being attached to the mast: relation/placement error.

assistantVisualInspection.conclusion: Geometry 5/12 is not semantic success; the 80% meaningful co-creation target has NOT been demonstrated.

decisions.reason: Candidate model did not improve this bounded comparison; even with supplied correct scene it passed 0/12.

methodology: Production source, thresholds, wire API and frozen fixtures were not edited.
Each resolution comparison retains the exact compiled proposal and original raster within its source-size group.
512-source compares 256/512 grids; 1024-source is re-rendered from original synthetic vectors and compares 256/512/1024 grids. No upscaling or fake 1024 occupancy from a 512 image.

1024 scenes are remeasured/recompiled once, using canvasSize=1024 and the same CSS brush widths. Between-source differences therefore include physical stroke scale and remeasured contacts; compare map resolutions within each source group.
Original raster uses 4px round stroke at each source size; negatives are authored synthetic controls, not model quality claims.
